title: pr-team terminals.jsonl - fixer row
description: Schema for terminals.jsonl rows emitted by Step 5 parallel subagent fixer fan-out AND the Step 6 closer return. Fixer agents may emit DONE / FAIL / FORK_AMBIGUITY / FORK_BLOCKER / STOP signals. The closer is technically agent_role=fixer with the literal agent_id `closer` and `edited: 1`. Common field $defs live in terminals.common.schema.json.

signal.description: Fixer-allowable verbs. Fixers CAN emit FORK_* (design-fork authority on mid-batch ambiguity).
signal.$comment: `STOP` may appear in terminals.jsonl. `STOP_PROTOCOL` may not.

fixed.description: DONE-fixer: array of issue IDs the fixer successfully resolved in its batch. Disjoint from `bubbled`. For the closer row, this is the aggregate of all fixer DONE rows' `fixed` arrays (validated RESOLVED-status entries from post_review_resolutions[]).

bubbled.description: DONE-fixer: array of issue IDs the fixer is bubbling up within its batch (encountered mid-batch ambiguity, classified as needing user decision, OR a fixer-FAILed peer's IDs collected at closer). Disjoint from `fixed`. Individual fixers usually leave this empty; the closer enumerates the full unresolved set.

edited.description: DONE-fixer: distinct file count the fixer edited. For individual fixers, MUST be >= 1 (zero-file edit = should have been FAIL or FORK_BLOCKER). For the closer (agent_id == 'closer'), MUST be exactly 1 (the single atomic Edit to the consolidated JSON).

evidence.description: DONE-fixer: per-id evidence claims for each fixed issue ID. Keys MUST correspond to the IDs in the fixed array; qa_review_json.py enforces exact key/value correspondence. Values are one-line claims of the fixer's work (e.g., 'L88 _is_skip rewritten to defensive substring; verified via Read post-edit').
evidence.$comment: Enforced by check C5 (check_c5_evidence_coverage) in qa_review_json.py - bidirectional check: evidence keys MUST equal fixed[] (no missing, no extras). JSON Schema cannot express the cross-field exact-correspondence constraint directly.

option_a.description: FORK_AMBIGUITY: one-line description of option A.

option_b.description: FORK_AMBIGUITY: one-line description of option B.

external_action_needed.description: FORK_BLOCKER: one-line description of what must happen outside the skill.

then.description: DONE-fixer requires `fixed` (array of resolved IDs), `bubbled` (array of bubble-up IDs, possibly empty), `edited` (file count), and `output_path`. Invariant `total_assigned == len(fixed) + len(bubbled)` is scope-specific (per-fixer batch OR closer-aggregate) and enforced by qa_review_json.py C-checks, not by schema.
Closer row MUST have edited == 1 (single atomic Edit to consolidated JSON).

Closer row signal MUST be one of DONE / FORK_AMBIGUITY / STOP. FAIL and FORK_BLOCKER are reserved for regular Step 5 fixer subagents - the closer's atomic Edit must succeed, and on Edit failure the closer emits STOP.
Non-closer fixer DONE rows MUST have edited >= 1 (zero-file edit = should have been FAIL or FORK_BLOCKER).
DONE-fixer with non-empty fixed array MUST have a non-empty evidence object. Keys MUST correspond exactly to the IDs in the fixed array - C5 in qa_review_json.py enforces bidirectional equality.
DONE-fixer with empty fixed array MUST omit evidence.
